DEVELOPMENT FALLBACK MODEL
==========================

Bicolor Cat by kenchoo
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)
Source/project reference:
https://github.com/code4fukui/vr-cats
https://sketchfab.com/kenchoo

The fallback model is loaded from the public vr-cats repository only when
/public/models/getingo-buddy/getingo-buddy.glb is not present.

For production, replace the fallback with the custom Getingo Buddy GLB and update/remove
this attribution only if the fallback is no longer used anywhere.
